## Description {#details}

<p>This file exposes functions that may be used with BuildMI from the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/machineinstrbuilder-h">MachineInstrBuilder.h</a> file to handle M68k'isms in a clean way.</p>


<p>TODO The BuildMem function may be used with the BuildMI function to add entire memory references in a single, typed, function call. M68k memory references can be very complex expressions (described in the README), so wrapping them up behind an easier to use interface makes sense. Descriptions of the functions are included below.</p>


<p>For reference, the order of operands for memory references is: (Operand), Base, Scale, Index, Displacement.</p>
